metadata.title: GRC Pipeline: Terraform AWS bucket with policy-as-code gate and signed evidence

components.title: grc-terraform-aws-bucket pipeline
components.description: Terraform-defined S3 storage with Rego policies enforced by a CI gate on every pull request, keyless-signed evidence bundles, and native AWS monitoring.

control-implementations.description: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 controls implemented and evidenced by this pipeline.

implemented-requirements.description: Every S3 bucket has server-side encryption at rest (AES256) through an aws_s3_bucket_server_side_encryption_configuration that references it. The SC-28 Rego policy (policies/sc28_encryption_aws.rego) denies any plan with an unencrypted bucket, and the grc-gate workflow blocks the merge.

links.text: Keyless-signed evidence bundle from grc-gate (PR #12): CI-generated plan and policy results. Sidecar .sha256 and .sig.bundle in the same folder; verify with verify-evidence.sh.

implemented-requirements.description: Every S3 bucket has an aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block that references it, with block_public_acls, block_public_policy, ignore_public_acls and restrict_public_buckets all set to true, so neither bucket can be made public through ACLs or bucket policies. The AC-3 Rego policy (policies/ac3_no_public_aws.rego) denies any plan where a bucket has no public access block or any of the four flags is not true, and the grc-gate workflow blocks the merge.

links.text: Keyless-signed evidence bundle from grc-gate (PR #12): CI-generated plan and policy results. Sidecar .sha256 and .sig.bundle in the same folder; verify with verify-evidence.sh.

implemented-requirements.description: The primary bucket's S3 server access logs are delivered to the separate log bucket under log/ (aws_s3_bucket_logging), recording the requester, time, action and response status for each request. Implemented in Terraform but not enforced by a Rego policy in the grc-gate; the CI-generated plan in the evidence bundle shows the configuration.

links.text: Keyless-signed evidence bundle from grc-gate (PR #12): CI-generated plan and policy results. Sidecar .sha256 and .sig.bundle in the same folder; verify with verify-evidence.sh.

implemented-requirements.description: Every taggable resource carries the four baseline tags (Project, Environment, ManagedBy, ComplianceScope) through the AWS provider's default_tags, and the primary bucket has versioning enabled (aws_s3_bucket_versioning). The CM-6 Rego policy (policies/cm6_required_tags_aws.rego) denies any plan where a taggable resource is missing a required tag, and the grc-gate workflow blocks the merge. Versioning is implemented in Terraform but not enforced by a policy.
